title: Bilingual editorial workflow verified locally: 113 passing regressions
summary: Persistent revisions, exact-version review, owner publication, conflict-safe rollback and late-AI/legacy-path protection implemented locally. Hosted execution remains blocked.

changes.detail: Append-only bilingual revisions and events; source/version-bound draft save/import/review, owner-only publication and snapshot rollback. UI preserves conflicted text, supports explicit rebase and history, and public product descriptions use current approved French content.

Shared admin-policy mapping now admits authorized editors. Final SQL guard blocks legacy manual/routine-AI approval/reset once editorial revisions exist, preventing bypass of reviewed owner publication. Noneditorial entities retain legacy behavior.
